in_arabic.name: سَكِينَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: سَكِينَة: المكان الذي يرتاح إليه العبد، والشعور بالسكون والراحة، والخلاص من المخاوف والتوترات، والانطباع بالاطمئنان والاطمئنان. وهي كلمة مهمة في الإسلام، حيث تشير إلى حالة من الراحة والهدوء الداخلية، والتي يوصي الله بها في القرآن. وتعد سكينة إحدى أهم الصفات التي يُريد الله من عباده أن يمتلكوها، حيث قال تعالى: "وَتَرَكَها بِقَصَدِ سَكِينَةٍ" (الفرقان: 62).

in_urdu.name: سکینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: سکینہ: وہ مقام جو ہر ایک کی روح کو سکون، خوشی اور اطمینان کے ساتھ لے جاتا ہے۔ یہ کلمہ اسلام میں بہت اہمیت کا حامل ہے کیونکہ وہ سکون، راحت اور خوشی کے جذبات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو اسلام کی تعلیمات کے مطابق ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सकीनाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: सकीनाह: जिसे व्यक्ति को सुख, शांति और समाधान की अनुभूति होती है। यह शब्द इस्लामिक परंपराओं में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, जो अपने अनुयायियों को शांति और भलाई की ओर प्रेरित करता है।

in_pashto.name: سکینه
in_pashto.long_meaning: سکینه: دا هغه ځای چې ګډوډیو څخه خلاصی او سکون ورکوي. دې کلمې په اسلام کې لوی اهميت درلوده، کله چې اسلامي علماء دې کلمې په خپلو آثارو کې استعمال کړی وو.

in_english.name: Sakeenah
in_english.meaning: peaceful, serene, calm, tranquil, serene, and content
in_english.long_meaning: Sakeenah is an Arabic name that conveys a sense of peace, serenity, and calmness. It is a state of being that is highly valued in Islam, where it is seen as a reflection of one's inner peace and contentment. In the Quran, Allah encourages His servants to seek this state, saying "and left it with the intention of being at peace" (25:62).

data.cultural_impact: The name Sakeenah holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic tradition. It was originally the nickname of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) wife, Aisha bint Abu Bakr, due to her unwavering composure and tranquility. Aisha was known for her strong faith and unwavering devotion to the Prophet (pbuh) and Islam, despite facing numerous trials and challenges. Thus, the name Sakeenah came to symbolize strength and resilience in the face of adversity, as well as the calming presence of a loving wife and support system. Today, the name is still loved and cherished by parents in the Islamic community as a name for their daughters, instilling in them the values of compassion, calmness, and inner strength.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Sakeenah serves as a reminder of the calm and peaceful presence of Allah (swt) in our lives. As we face various trials and challenges, Allah (swt) is our source of strength and support, providing us with the tranquility and peace that we need to overcome adversity. The name Sakeenah also encourages us to strive for inner peace and calmness, allowing us to better focus on our connection with Allah (swt) and the spiritual journey towards becoming better Muslims. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Allah's mercy is expressed in tranquility," emphasizing the importance of seeking inner peace and tranquility in our spiritual lives. Thus, the name Sakeenah not only serves as a reminder of the supportive and calming presence of Allah (swt) and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), but also as a call to strive for inner peace and tranquility in our own lives.
